findings.claim: Any value outside the known routes still falls through to the generic skill route (routes.go:23-25, 282-301), so a misspelling of the new scoped value fails open. For example, `_shared/x/run.sh custom claude-skills` or `Claude-Skill` is not in skillRouteTargets, so it gets a Dest under every copy target's skills root, including ~/.codex/skills, the deployment T20 removes. Nothing refuses or warns about it. The four current rows are protected by the exact-value check in TestEvidenceStore_ManifestHoldsFourClaudeSkillRows; future Claude-only rows have no such guard. Possible fixes: refuse an unknown third column on a custom row, or add a manifest-wide test that every third column is a known route.
